name: Maryland

windshield.strip: post manufacture tint may not be applied below the AS1 line or below 5 inches from the top of the windshield, whichever is less
windshield.reflective: no mirrored, one-way vision or sparkling tint on any window or windshield

frontSide.note: passenger cars, convertibles, station wagons (registered under § 13-912)

backSide.note: all windows of a passenger car are regulated

rear.note: outside rearview mirror on each side required when side or rear windows are tinted; no tint in front of an inside high-mounted stop lamp

windshield.strip: not below the AS1 line or below 5 inches from the top, whichever is less
windshield.reflective: no mirrored, one-way vision or sparkling tint

frontSide.note: light trucks, vans and multipurpose passenger vehicles (§§ 13-913, 13-917, 13-937): windows immediately right and left of the driver

backSide.note: windows to the rear of the driver may be tinted to any degree of darkness

rear.note: outside rearview mirror on each side required

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ("light transmittance through the window", "after the application of post manufacture window tint")

reflectivity.front: mirrored, one-way vision or sparkling effect prohibited (no % stated)
reflectivity.back: mirrored, one-way vision or sparkling effect prohibited (no % stated)

colorsBanned: tint that changes to red, yellow or amber
tint.dualMirrors: Required on any vehicle with permitted post manufacture tint on any side or rear window (COMAR 11.14.02.14D(2)).
tint.certificateOrSticker: No sticker required. Tint manufacturer labels, if any, may not affect the driver's vision or obscure the glazing manufacturer's trademark or AS indicator (COMAR 11.14.02.14D(5)).

medicalExemption.text: Owner must carry a written certification from a physician licensed in Maryland, in the format required by the State Police Automotive Safety Enforcement Division (form ASED 23-04B). Valid for the period the physician sets, max 2 years, or indefinitely if the physician finds the condition permanent (2025 amendment). Applies to regulated windows only; windshield still limited to AS1 line / 5 inches. Easily removable shades protecting a child under 10 are also exempt.

penalty.text: Misdemeanor under the Maryland Vehicle Law, fine not exceeding $500 (general penalty); officer may also issue a safety equipment repair order (§ 23-105). Preset District Court fine not checked.

quotes: § 22-406(i)(1)(i): "there is affixed to any window of the vehicle any tinting materials added to the window after manufacture of the vehicle that do not allow a light transmittance through the window of at least 35%"

§ 22-406(i)(1)(ii): "there is affixed to any window to the immediate right or left of the driver any window tinting materials added after manufacture of the vehicle that do not allow a light transmittance through the window of at least 35%"
COMAR 11.14.02.14D(2)(a)(ii): "Post manufacture window tint may not be applied to the windshield below the AS1 line or below 5 inches from the top of the windshield, whichever is less."
COMAR 11.14.02.14D(2)(b)(iii): "Windows of these vehicles to the rear of the driver may be tinted with post manufacture window tint to any degree of darkness."
COMAR 11.14.02.14D(1): "(a) Has a mirrored or one-way vision effect or a sparkling effect; (b) Is red, yellow, or amber in color; or (c) Changes to a red, yellow, or amber color."
§ 22-406(i)(4)(ii)2: "If the licensed physician determines that the owner's medical condition is permanent, a written certification under this paragraph shall be valid indefinitely."

helmet.conditions: every operator and rider, except in an enclosed cab; eye protection or windscreen also required

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Under 18: no wireless communication device at all (§ 21-1124(c)); learner's permit or provisional licence holders 18+ and school-bus drivers carrying passengers: no handheld phone (§ 21-1124.2(c))
handheldPhone.fineText: Handheld: first offense max $75, second $125, third+ $175; first-offense fine may be waived on proof of a hands-free accessory. Texting: misdemeanor, max $500 (§ 27-101)

studdedTires.season: Nov 1 - Mar 31, only for vehicles registered in Allegany, Carroll, Frederick, Garrett or Washington County (and emergency vehicles); otherwise prohibited for Maryland-registered vehicles; non-Maryland vehicles exempt

radarDetector.note: No Maryland ban on radar detectors in passenger vehicles found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

liftHeight.rule: After post-manufacture alterations, frame side rails or either bumper may not exceed 20 in. (Class A passenger), 28 in. (Class M multipurpose), 28 in. (Class E truck up to 10,000 lb), 30 in. (Class E 10,001-18,000 lb; 32 in. for crop-spraying trucks); any alteration reducing bumper/suspension effectiveness is banned
